text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: AutoPager fired for inference-gateway-prod — high 5xx rate detected (1m window 12%). PD: INC1234567 https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC1234567

evan_oncall: Acked on PD — taking ownership. I'll triage now.

jen-sre: Looking at traces and kvcache metrics. Spike looks like many short-lived 502s from inference-proxy.

maria-eng: Confirmed. /v1/generate on gw-edge-4 returning `502 Bad Gateway` with upstream timeouts ~1200ms.

alex-cs: CS: received 2 tickets from mid-market customer about errors; asking for ETA, will update.

evan_oncall: Quick plan: 1) confirm region impact 2) shift traffic off gw-edge-4 -> fallback pool 3) run a quick sidecar recycle & warm-up. Applying now.

jen-sre: Running query on logs:
```
2026-03-17T00:00:01Z gw-edge-4 -> inference-proxy: 502 "upstream timeout" ctx=request_id=abc123
2026-03-17T00:00:02Z kvcache: eviction spike, miss_rate=0.78
```

maria-eng: kvcache miss rate jump lines up with rollout of model-a quantized variant ~23m ago. Could be cold KV thrashing.

evan_oncall: Rerouted 40% of prod traffic off gw-edge-4 to pool-b (cmd: `rbacctl route set-weight gw-edge-4 60% pool-b 40%`). Monitoring latency & 5xx.

pagerbot: Note: If error rate doesn't drop by 5m, autopage escalation will add oncall-2.

jen-sre: Temporarily disabled continuous-batching on pool-b (to reduce backend pressure) and triggered sidecar restart on inference-sidecar-4.

maria-eng: Restart complete on sidecar-4, warming kv entries via internal warmup job.

evan_oncall: 5xx rate down to 3% after reroute and recycle. Latency normalizing. :thumbsup:

alex-cs: Passed to CS — will tell affected customers we're monitoring, expect full recovery in 10m.

incident-bot: Marking as mitigated (manual). Root-cause suspected: kvcache eviction cascade after model-variant rollout. Creating follow-up: RFC + postmortem. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx-kvcache

jen-sre: Filing postmortem draft, will include rollout revert & stricter canary thresholds. Thanks all.

evan_oncall: Closing incident in PD. Handoff: jen-sre will lead follow-up. Good job team.
